data.title: What Medtronic (MDT)'s Cornerstone Robotics Deal Means For Shareholders
data.description: Medtronic plc recently announced a partnership with Cornerstone Robotics, committing about US$700 million and securing rights to distribute Cornerstone’s Sentire surgical system in select approved markets outside the U.S., where it will be offered alongside Medtronic’s Hugo robotic-assisted surgery platform. This move effectively broadens Medtronic’s robotic surgery portfolio, giving hospitals and surgeons more choice across complementary platforms that can plug into the company’s connected...
